newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cofap to build plants in U.S., Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cofap to build plants in U.S., Argentina.

text.p: Brazilian car parts maker Cofap will invest $80 million next year to build factories in the United States and Argentina, a company spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman confirmed a local newspaper report that the company plans to erect a plant in Cordoba, Argentina, and another in either Tennesee, Kentucky or Virginia.
She said Cofap plans to invest $32 million to build the U.S. plant which will build four million shock absorbers a year for use in Chrysler Corp trucks, pick-ups and vans.
The remaining $48 million will be invested in the Argentine plant which will supply shock-absorbers for Fiat SpA cars, she said.
The company currently produces 16 million shock absorbers a year, she said.
She declined to give further details.
